content.content:
1	# Implementation Plan: P-RF10 — Save a chat message as an entry
2	
3	**Branch**: `008-chat-message-bookmark` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; none of this repo's
4	extension hooks are configured, per spec.md's own header)
5	
6	**Date**: 2026-10-21 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
7	
8	**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/008-chat-message-bookmark/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
9	§1 (RF10), §6.2/6.3 (`entries-create`'s `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` fields, already documented as shared
10	between RF01 and RF10), §8 (data model reference — `entries.chat_message_id`), §12 (delivery order: RF10 after
11	RF01 and RF04, both already implemented), §13; `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` POST schema
12	(`chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` already accepted, optional, `format: uuid`/`format: date-time`);
13	`docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` ("Never `409` — the idempotency of RF10 ... always answers `200`");
14	`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.2 ("Tela 1 — Bookmark") and its inline component table; the
15	prototype's own source (`docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`, the bookmark row's exact markup/styles);
16	and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on RF01 (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`) and RF04
17	(`specs/007-chat-memory-rag/`), both already implemented — this is the unit that connects chat's own
18	messages to the entry-creation seam RF01 built and already annotated for this exact extension
19	(`create_entry_usecase.dart`: "RF10 will extend this signature, never bypass it").
20	
21	## Summary
22	
23	Every user message in Home/Chat gains a bookmark control with the prototype's own four sub-states — `idle`,
24	`saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning) — that turns that one message into a
25	persisted journal entry via the exact same `CreateEntryUseCase` RF01 already established, now extended with
26	two new optional parameters (`chatMessageId`, `occurredAt`) that thread straight through
27	`EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRepositoryImpl`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` to `entries-create`'s already-documented
28	request fields — no backend change, no new endpoint, no new repository. `ChatBloc` (RF04) gains exactly one
29	new dependency, `CreateEntryUseCase` itself (a domain usecase, never a repository or data source — the literal
30	seam FR-009 names), one new event (`BookmarkTapped(messageId)`), and one new `ChatReady` field (`bookmarks: Map<String,
31	BookmarkStatus>`, keyed by message id) tracking each message's bookmark sub-state in memory for the lifetime of
32	the bloc. `ChatRepository`/`ChatRepositoryImpl`/`ChatLocalCache` (also RF04) each gain a small, device-local,
33	Keychain-backed record of "which chat message ids have already produced an entry" (`savedEntryIdFor`/
34	`recordMessageSaved`) — a convenience for FR-008's "still shows `saved` after reopening/restarting," never the
35	source of correctness, since the backend's own `entries-create` idempotency (keyed by `chatMessageId`, confirmed
36	`200` not `409` on a repeat) already guarantees no duplicate regardless of what this local record remembers or
37	forgets. One new presentation widget, `BookmarkButton`, renders the four sub-states with two new, exact-value
38	`DesignTokens` (`sizeBookmarkIcon`, `spacingBookmarkGap`) read directly off the prototype's own inline bookmark
39	markup; `ChatMessageBubble`'s existing user-message branch is extended to lay the bubble and the bookmark
40	side by side in a row, matching that markup exactly. No change to `records/`, `export/`, `dashboard/`, any
41	backend file, or any file under `docs/input/`.
42	
43	## Technical Context
44	
45	**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
46	F000/RF01–RF07.
47	
48	**Primary Dependencies**: No additions. Reuses `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `get_it`, `equatable`,
49	`flutter_secure_storage` (for `ChatLocalCache`'s one new key), `dio` (via the already-registered
50	`entries-create` function, unchanged shape); dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`.
51	
52	**Storage**: One new key on the existing `ChatLocalCache` (`chatSavedMessageEntryIds` → `Map<String, String>`,
53	`chatMessageId` → `entryId`), same Keychain-backed, JSON-encoded mechanism `EntriesLocalCache`/`ChatLocalCache`
54	already use for personal content (research.md R1). No new local-cache class, no new third-party persistence
55	package.
56	
57	**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, unchanged tooling. Coverage via
58	`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter (RNF07) — now additionally exercising
59	`bookmark_status.dart` (a pure enum) and `ChatBloc`'s new `_onBookmarkTapped` branches (testable with the same
60	`MockChatRepository`/`MockCreateEntryUseCase`-via-`MockEntriesRepository` pattern `chat_bloc_test.dart`/
61	`create_entry_usecase_test.dart` already establish). `no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart` and
62	`domain_purity_test.dart` both run unmodified against the extended `lib/features/chat/` — no new bloc, no new
63	flutter/data import in `chat/domain/`. `test/architecture/no_cross_feature_data_imports_test.dart` (new,
64	already passing against the pre-RF10 codebase) is the one that enforces FR-009's actual constraint — no direct
65	`EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` import from `chat/presentation/bloc/` — which the other two tests
66	are not scoped to catch.
67	
68	**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. No native project file touched.
69	
70	**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app. No new feature folder — every change lands inside the two
71	already-existing folders this unit depends on (`lib/features/chat/`, `lib/features/entries/`), plus two
72	`core/` token additions and one `core/di/` registration update. No backend/server code, no change to
73	`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml` (its `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` fields on `entries-create` already
74	exist and are simply used for the first time).
75	
76	**Performance Goals**: RNF01 unchanged. The bookmark's `saving` state (shown the instant the tap is handled,
77	before the network call resolves) is this unit's own "<100 ms local reflection"; the spinner itself is the
78	required loading indicator for the network call that follows (always well past the 300 ms threshold in
79	practice for a write endpoint already doing PII-check + embedding server-side).
80	
81	**Constraints**:
82	- No RF08 (proactive insight)/RF05 (export)/RF09 (dashboard), no extension feature, no backend/contract/
83	  config change (FR-010) — `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` are fields `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`
84	  already declares on `entries-create`'s request body; nothing new is sent that the contract doesn't already
85	  define.
86	- Entry creation from chat MUST go through `CreateEntryUseCase` only, never `EntriesRepository`/
87	  `EntriesRemoteDataSource` directly (FR-009) — enforced by construction: `chat_bloc.dart`'s only new import
88	  from `features/entries/` is `create_entry_usecase.dart` (+ `entry.dart` for the `EntrySource` enum already
89	  used identically by every other `source` value chat never touches otherwise).
90	- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V) — the one new domain file,
91	  `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_status.dart`, is a bare enum: no `package:flutter`, no
92	  `chat/data/` import (confirmed against `domain_purity_test.dart`, unmodified). `ChatBloc`'s dependency
93	  surface grows by exactly one domain usecase (`CreateEntryUseCase`) — no new cross-bloc import.
94	- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — every bookmark
95	  color is reused verbatim (`colorTextSecondary`/`colorAccent`/`colorError`, already defined); the icon size
96	  (16 dp) and the bubble-to-icon gap (6 dp) are new, exact-value tokens (`sizeBookmarkIcon`,
97	  `spacingBookmarkGap`) because neither matches an existing 4 dp-grid step, mirroring the precedent already set
98	  by `sizeAudioRecordIcon`/`sizePhotoTileIcon`/`borderWidthFocused` (RF01–RF03) for off-grid, element-specific
99	  values read straight off the prototype.
100	- Idempotency (FR-004) is **not** reimplemented client-side — it is the backend's own guarantee
101	  (`error-taxonomy.md`: "Never `409`... always answers `200`"). The device-local `savedEntryIdFor` record is
102	  explicitly a convenience for FR-008's UI-continuity requirement, never a correctness mechanism (spec.md's own
103	  Assumptions already say so) — this plan does not invent a second, client-side dedup guarantee on top of it.
104	
105	**Scale/Scope**: 0 new feature folders. 1 new domain entity (`bookmark_status.dart`), 1 new presentation widget
106	(`bookmark_button.dart`); 8 existing files extended (`create_entry_usecase.dart`, `entries_repository.dart`,
107	`entries_repository_impl.dart`, `entries_remote_data_source.dart`, `chat_repository.dart`,
108	`chat_repository_impl.dart`, `chat_local_cache.dart`, `chat_event.dart`/`chat_state.dart`/`chat_bloc.dart`,
109	`chat_message_bubble.dart`, `home_chat_shell_page.dart`); 2 new `DesignTokens` constants; 1 DI registration
110	updated (no new registration — `CreateEntryUseCase` is already registered by RF01).
111	
112	## Constitution Check
113	
114	*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this section.*
115	
116	| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
117	|---|---|---|
118	| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only throughout. Every judgment call below (research.md R1–R10) fills a gap spec.md itself already flags as "an implementation decision for the planning phase" (FR-009's shared-interface shape, FR-003's `saved`-state non-tappability) or that neither `requirements.md` nor the prototype addresses (the optimistic-message-id race, R6; the device-local record's exact storage shape, R1) — none reopens a Clarification spec.md already resolved. |
119	| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | No new package. `flutter_bloc`/`fpdart`/`get_it`/`flutter_secure_storage` all already project dependencies. |
120	| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | Only the already-contracted `entries-create` function is called, now with two of its already-declared optional request fields (`chatMessageId`/`occurredAt`) populated for the first time; no AI provider called directly; no OpenAPI/`.env`/config file touched. |
121	| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | Every bookmark color reused verbatim; the two new size/spacing tokens are exact values transcribed from the prototype's own inline bookmark markup (research.md R7), not approximations. |
122	| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | `bookmark_status.dart` imports nothing beyond the Dart core library; `ChatBloc`'s new dependency (`CreateEntryUseCase`) is a domain usecase, not a repository/data source — confirmed against `domain_purity_test.dart`/`no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart` (unmodified) and the new, narrowly-scoped `test/architecture/no_cross_feature_data_imports_test.dart`, which is the one that actually catches `chat_bloc.dart` importing `EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` directly. |
123	| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | The `saving` state is this unit's own instant local reflection; the spinner is the loading indicator the network call (always realistically >300 ms for a PII-check+embedding write) requires. |
124	| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF10 directly | Chat-sourced entries run through the exact same backend `entries-create` pipeline as every other source (spec.md Assumptions) — no new client-side PII logic, no new retention policy, RLS unaffected (same `auth.uid() = user_id` entries table). |
125	| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A | Belongs to Settings/RNF05's own unit. |
126	| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | `chat/domain/` stays flutter/data-free; `ChatBloc` never imports `EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` (FR-009's own wording is also RNF06's own concern per spec.md: "a violation here also breaks RNF06") — confirmed by `chat_bloc.dart`'s planned import list containing only `create_entry_usecase.dart`/`entry.dart` from `features/entries/`. |
127	| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | `bookmark_status.dart` is a trivial enum (same tier as `EntrySource`/`ChatRole`); the more substantial new logic (`_seedBookmarks`, `_onBookmarkTapped`'s branches, `ChatRepositoryImpl.savedEntryIdFor`/`recordMessageSaved`) is tested the same `mocktail`-driven way every other `ChatBloc`/`ChatRepositoryImpl` branch already is. |
128	| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS | Bookmark icon/size/color/gap/spin-animation match the prototype's own inline bookmark markup exactly (research.md R7) — transcribed, not approximated. |
129	| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | No new write endpoint — `entries-create` is already one of RNF09's counted 5 endpoints (its 3 base failure scenarios already covered by RF01's own tests); this unit adds scenario-table rows specific to the bookmark path (idempotent-retry outcome, `AuthExpiredFailure` → `reauthRequired`) on top of, not instead of, that existing coverage (contracts/create-entry-usecase-chat-extension.md). |
130	
131	*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*
132	
133	## Project Structure
134	
135	### Documentation (this feature)
136	
137	```text
138	specs/008-chat-message-bookmark/
139	├── plan.md                                          # This file
140	├── research.md                                      # Phase 0 output
141	├── data-model.md                                    # Phase 1 output
142	├── quickstart.md                                     # Phase 1 output
143	├── contracts/                                        # Phase 1 output
144	│   ├── create-entry-usecase-chat-extension.md
145	│   ├── chat-repository-bookmark-extension.md
146	│   └── chat-bloc-bookmark-extension.md
147	└── tasks.md                                          # Phase 2 output (/speckit-tasks — not created here)
148	```
149	
150	### Source Code (repository root)
151	
152	```text
153	cerne-ciclo-a/
154	└── lib/
155	    ├── core/
156	    │   ├── design_tokens.dart                         # + sizeBookmarkIcon, spacingBookmarkGap (research.md R7)
157	    │   └── di/
158	    │       └── service_locator.dart                   # ChatBloc registration + createEntryUseCase param
159	    └── features/
160	        ├── entries/
161	        │   ├── domain/
162	        │   │   ├── usecases/
163	        │   │   │   └── create_entry_usecase.dart       # + chatMessageId/occurredAt params (research.md R2)
164	        │   │   └── repositories/
165	        │   │       └── entries_repository.dart         # create() signature extended, same params
166	        │   └── data/
167	        │       ├── entries_repository_impl.dart        # create() passes the two new params through
168	        │       └── entries_remote_data_source.dart      # create() sends them in the request body when non-null
169	        └── chat/
170	            ├── domain/
171	            │   ├── entities/
172	            │   │   └── bookmark_status.dart             # NEW — enum { idle, saving, saved, error }
173	            │   └── repositories/
174	            │       └── chat_repository.dart              # + savedEntryIdFor / recordMessageSaved (research.md R1)
175	            ├── data/
176	            │   ├── chat_local_cache.dart                 # + chatSavedMessageEntryIds key/methods
177	            │   └── chat_repository_impl.dart              # + the two new methods, 1 new in-memory field
178	            └── presentation/
179	                ├── bloc/
180	                │   ├── chat_event.dart                    # + BookmarkTapped(messageId)
181	                │   ├── chat_state.dart                    # + ChatReady.bookmarks, bookmarkStatusFor()
182	                │   └── chat_bloc.dart                      # + CreateEntryUseCase dep, _onBookmarkTapped, _seedBookmarks
183	                └── widgets/
184	                    ├── bookmark_button.dart                # NEW — 4-state icon control
185	                    └── chat_message_bubble.dart             # extended — bubble+bookmark row for user messages
186	        └── home/
187	            └── presentation/
188	                └── pages/

190	```
191	
192	**Structure Decision**: No new feature folder. Every change lands inside `chat/` and `entries/`, the two
193	folders FR-009 itself names as the ones this unit bridges — `chat/` gains the one new domain enum a bookmark
194	needs (`BookmarkStatus`) and extends its own repository/bloc/widgets; `entries/` only widens an already-planned
195	extension point (`CreateEntryUseCase`'s own doc comment has said "RF10 will extend this signature" since RF01
196	shipped). `core/design_tokens.dart` and `core/di/service_locator.dart` are touched because they are the two
197	single-source-of-truth files every unit touches when it needs a new visual value or a new DI wire-up — not
198	because this unit needs its own `core/` subsystem the way RF04's SSE transport did.
199	
200	## Complexity Tracking
201	
202	> **Fill ONLY if Constitution Check has violations that must be justified** — no row below is a violation;
203	> each documents a design choice research.md reasons through in full, kept here for traceability only.
204	
205	| Addition | Why Needed | Simpler Alternative Rejected Because |
206	|---|---|---|
207	| A device-local `savedEntryIdFor`/`recordMessageSaved` pair on `ChatRepository`, instead of deriving "already saved" from `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` | FR-008 needs a message's bookmark to show `saved` immediately on reopening a conversation/restarting the app; `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` is a synchronous getter with its own independent, unrelated lazy-load timing (research.md R1) not guaranteed populated by the time `ChatBloc` loads a session | Reading `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` directly from `ChatBloc` — rejected: couples a chat-local UI concern to a different feature's cache-loading lifecycle, and (per FR-009's own spirit, even though `cachedEntries` is a repository getter, not a creation path) adds a needless second entries-feature dependency to `ChatBloc` for a question `chat/`'s own local cache can already answer on its own |
208	| No dedicated `SaveChatMessageUseCase` wrapping `CreateEntryUseCase` + `ChatRepository.recordMessageSaved` | `ChatBloc` already has direct, synchronous access to the tapped message's `content`/`createdAt`/`id` — the two calls the bloc's own handler makes have no behavior of their own beyond what `_onBookmarkTapped` already needs inline (research.md R4, the same judgment RF04's own research.md R13 already made for every other `ChatBloc` handler) | A wrapper use case — rejected: zero added testability over mocking `CreateEntryUseCase`/`ChatRepository` directly at the same level `chat_bloc_test.dart` already mocks `ChatRepository`, for one extra file and DI registration |
209	| Guarding `_onBookmarkTapped` against an optimistic (`isOptimistic == true`) message id as a silent no-op | A message can render its bookmark before the backend assigns its real id (between the optimistic append and `message_created`); sending a `local-<timestamp>` string as `chatMessageId` would violate the OpenAPI field's `format: uuid` and either get rejected or write bad data — neither spec.md nor the prototype (which has no server-roundtrip concept) addresses this race (research.md R6) | Disabling/hiding the bookmark entirely while a message is optimistic — rejected: FR-001 requires the control to appear on every user message with no exceptions; a silent no-op tap, exactly like the already-established "ignore a tap while `saving`" pattern (FR-007), satisfies both FR-001 (always visible) and correctness (never sends a malformed id) without a new visual state |
210	
211	## Post-Design Constitution Check
212	
213	Re-evaluated after Phase 1 (data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md):
214	
215	- `bookmark_status.dart`'s planned import list re-checked: empty beyond Dart core — no `equatable` even needed
216	  for a plain enum, no `package:flutter`, no `chat/data/` class. RNF06/Principle V confirmed before any code
217	  exists.
218	- `ChatBloc`'s planned constructor re-checked: `ChatRepository` + `ConnectivityChecker` (unchanged) +
219	  `CreateEntryUseCase` (new) — no `EntriesRepository`, no `EntriesRemoteDataSource`, no second bloc. FR-009's
220	  "never directly import a repository or data source belonging to the entries feature" holds by construction
221	  and is now also mechanically checked by `test/architecture/no_cross_feature_data_imports_test.dart` (T042).

# Implementation Plan: P-RF10 — Save a chat message as an entry

**Branch**: `008-chat-message-bookmark` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; none of this repo's
extension hooks are configured, per spec.md's own header)

**Date**: 2026-10-21 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/008-chat-message-bookmark/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
§1 (RF10), §6.2/6.3 (`entries-create`'s `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` fields, already documented as shared
between RF01 and RF10), §8 (data model reference — `entries.chat_message_id`), §12 (delivery order: RF10 after
RF01 and RF04, both already implemented), §13; `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` POST schema
(`chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` already accepted, optional, `format: uuid`/`format: date-time`);
`docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` ("Never `409` — the idempotency of RF10 ... always answers `200`");
`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.2 ("Tela 1 — Bookmark") and its inline component table; the
prototype's own source (`docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`, the bookmark row's exact markup/styles);
and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on RF01 (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`) and RF04
(`specs/007-chat-memory-rag/`), both already implemented — this is the unit that connects chat's own
messages to the entry-creation seam RF01 built and already annotated for this exact extension
(`create_entry_usecase.dart`: "RF10 will extend this signature, never bypass it").

## Summary

Every user message in Home/Chat gains a bookmark control with the prototype's own four sub-states — `idle`,
`saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning) — that turns that one message into a
persisted journal entry via the exact same `CreateEntryUseCase` RF01 already established, now extended with
two new optional parameters (`chatMessageId`, `occurredAt`) that thread straight through
`EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRepositoryImpl`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` to `entries-create`'s already-documented
request fields — no backend change, no new endpoint, no new repository. `ChatBloc` (RF04) gains exactly one
new dependency, `CreateEntryUseCase` itself (a domain usecase, never a repository or data source — the literal
seam FR-009 names), one new event (`BookmarkTapped(messageId)`), and one new `ChatReady` field (`bookmarks: Map<String,
BookmarkStatus>`, keyed by message id) tracking each message's bookmark sub-state in memory for the lifetime of
the bloc. `ChatRepository`/`ChatRepositoryImpl`/`ChatLocalCache` (also RF04) each gain a small, device-local,
Keychain-backed record of "which chat message ids have already produced an entry" (`savedEntryIdFor`/
`recordMessageSaved`) — a convenience for FR-008's "still shows `saved` after reopening/restarting," never the
source of correctness, since the backend's own `entries-create` idempotency (keyed by `chatMessageId`, confirmed
`200` not `409` on a repeat) already guarantees no duplicate regardless of what this local record remembers or
forgets. One new presentation widget, `BookmarkButton`, renders the four sub-states with two new, exact-value
`DesignTokens` (`sizeBookmarkIcon`, `spacingBookmarkGap`) read directly off the prototype's own inline bookmark
markup; `ChatMessageBubble`'s existing user-message branch is extended to lay the bubble and the bookmark
side by side in a row, matching that markup exactly. No change to `records/`, `export/`, `dashboard/`, any
backend file, or any file under `docs/input/`.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
F000/RF01–RF07.

**Primary Dependencies**: No additions. Reuses `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `get_it`, `equatable`,
`flutter_secure_storage` (for `ChatLocalCache`'s one new key), `dio` (via the already-registered
`entries-create` function, unchanged shape); dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`.

**Storage**: One new key on the existing `ChatLocalCache` (`chatSavedMessageEntryIds` → `Map<String, String>`,
`chatMessageId` → `entryId`), same Keychain-backed, JSON-encoded mechanism `EntriesLocalCache`/`ChatLocalCache`
already use for personal content (research.md R1). No new local-cache class, no new third-party persistence
package.

**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, unchanged tooling. Coverage via
`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter (RNF07) — now additionally exercising
`bookmark_status.dart` (a pure enum) and `ChatBloc`'s new `_onBookmarkTapped` branches (testable with the same
`MockChatRepository`/`MockCreateEntryUseCase`-via-`MockEntriesRepository` pattern `chat_bloc_test.dart`/
`create_entry_usecase_test.dart` already establish). `no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart` and
`domain_purity_test.dart` both run unmodified against the extended `lib/features/chat/` — no new bloc, no new
flutter/data import in `chat/domain/`. `test/architecture/no_cross_feature_data_imports_test.dart` (new,
already passing against the pre-RF10 codebase) is the one that enforces FR-009's actual constraint — no direct
`EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` import from `chat/presentation/bloc/` — which the other two tests
are not scoped to catch.

**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. No native project file touched.

**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app. No new feature folder — every change lands inside the two
already-existing folders this unit depends on (`lib/features/chat/`, `lib/features/entries/`), plus two
`core/` token additions and one `core/di/` registration update. No backend/server code, no change to
`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml` (its `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` fields on `entries-create` already
exist and are simply used for the first time).

**Performance Goals**: RNF01 unchanged. The bookmark's `saving` state (shown the instant the tap is handled,
before the network call resolves) is this unit's own "<100 ms local reflection"; the spinner itself is the
required loading indicator for the network call that follows (always well past the 300 ms threshold in
practice for a write endpoint already doing PII-check + embedding server-side).

**Constraints**:
- No RF08 (proactive insight)/RF05 (export)/RF09 (dashboard), no extension feature, no backend/contract/
  config change (FR-010) — `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` are fields `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`
  already declares on `entries-create`'s request body; nothing new is sent that the contract doesn't already
  define.
- Entry creation from chat MUST go through `CreateEntryUseCase` only, never `EntriesRepository`/
  `EntriesRemoteDataSource` directly (FR-009) — enforced by construction: `chat_bloc.dart`'s only new import
  from `features/entries/` is `create_entry_usecase.dart` (+ `entry.dart` for the `EntrySource` enum already
  used identically by every other `source` value chat never touches otherwise).
- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V) — the one new domain file,
  `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_status.dart`, is a bare enum: no `package:flutter`, no
  `chat/data/` import (confirmed against `domain_purity_test.dart`, unmodified). `ChatBloc`'s dependency
  surface grows by exactly one domain usecase (`CreateEntryUseCase`) — no new cross-bloc import.
- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — every bookmark
  color is reused verbatim (`colorTextSecondary`/`colorAccent`/`colorError`, already defined); the icon size
  (16 dp) and the bubble-to-icon gap (6 dp) are new, exact-value tokens (`sizeBookmarkIcon`,
  `spacingBookmarkGap`) because neither matches an existing 4 dp-grid step, mirroring the precedent already set
  by `sizeAudioRecordIcon`/`sizePhotoTileIcon`/`borderWidthFocused` (RF01–RF03) for off-grid, element-specific
  values read straight off the prototype.
- Idempotency (FR-004) is **not** reimplemented client-side — it is the backend's own guarantee
  (`error-taxonomy.md`: "Never `409`... always answers `200`"). The device-local `savedEntryIdFor` record is
  explicitly a convenience for FR-008's UI-continuity requirement, never a correctness mechanism (spec.md's own
  Assumptions already say so) — this plan does not invent a second, client-side dedup guarantee on top of it.

**Scale/Scope**: 0 new feature folders. 1 new domain entity (`bookmark_status.dart`), 1 new presentation widget
(`bookmark_button.dart`); 8 existing files extended (`create_entry_usecase.dart`, `entries_repository.dart`,
`entries_repository_impl.dart`, `entries_remote_data_source.dart`, `chat_repository.dart`,
`chat_repository_impl.dart`, `chat_local_cache.dart`, `chat_event.dart`/`chat_state.dart`/`chat_bloc.dart`,
`chat_message_bubble.dart`, `home_chat_shell_page.dart`); 2 new `DesignTokens` constants; 1 DI registration
updated (no new registration — `CreateEntryUseCase` is already registered by RF01).

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this section.*

| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only throughout. Every judgment call below (research.md R1–R10) fills a gap spec.md itself already flags as "an implementation decision for the planning phase" (FR-009's shared-interface shape, FR-003's `saved`-state non-tappability) or that neither `requirements.md` nor the prototype addresses (the optimistic-message-id race, R6; the device-local record's exact storage shape, R1) — none reopens a Clarification spec.md already resolved. |
| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | No new package. `flutter_bloc`/`fpdart`/`get_it`/`flutter_secure_storage` all already project dependencies. |
| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | Only the already-contracted `entries-create` function is called, now with two of its already-declared optional request fields (`chatMessageId`/`occurredAt`) populated for the first time; no AI provider called directly; no OpenAPI/`.env`/config file touched. |
| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | Every bookmark color reused verbatim; the two new size/spacing tokens are exact values transcribed from the prototype's own inline bookmark markup (research.md R7), not approximations. |
| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | `bookmark_status.dart` imports nothing beyond the Dart core library; `ChatBloc`'s new dependency (`CreateEntryUseCase`) is a domain usecase, not a repository/data source — confirmed against `domain_purity_test.dart`/`no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart` (unmodified) and the new, narrowly-scoped `test/architecture/no_cross_feature_data_imports_test.dart`, which is the one that actually catches `chat_bloc.dart` importing `EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` directly. |
| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | The `saving` state is this unit's own instant local reflection; the spinner is the loading indicator the network call (always realistically >300 ms for a PII-check+embedding write) requires. |
| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF10 directly | Chat-sourced entries run through the exact same backend `entries-create` pipeline as every other source (spec.md Assumptions) — no new client-side PII logic, no new retention policy, RLS unaffected (same `auth.uid() = user_id` entries table). |
| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A | Belongs to Settings/RNF05's own unit. |
| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | `chat/domain/` stays flutter/data-free; `ChatBloc` never imports `EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` (FR-009's own wording is also RNF06's own concern per spec.md: "a violation here also breaks RNF06") — confirmed by `chat_bloc.dart`'s planned import list containing only `create_entry_usecase.dart`/`entry.dart` from `features/entries/`. |

| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | No new write endpoint — `entries-create` is already one of RNF09's counted 5 endpoints (its 3 base failure scenarios already covered by RF01's own tests); this unit adds scenario-table rows specific to the bookmark path (idempotent-retry outcome, `AuthExpiredFailure` → `reauthRequired`) on top of, not instead of, that existing coverage (contracts/create-entry-usecase-chat-extension.md). |

*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*

  `EntriesRemoteDataSource.create` (`SaveTextEntryUseCase`, `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`, and their manual/audio/
  photo call sites) omits both new named parameters and is therefore byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged — no

1	# Research: P-RF10 — Save a chat message as an entry
2	
3	Phase 0 output. Each item is a reasonable technical decision made under Constitution Principle I ("where these
4	documents are silent, implementers MUST make a reasonable technical decision rather than block on
5	clarification"). None reopens spec.md's own already-resolved calls (FR-003's `saved`-state non-tappability,
6	FR-009's "shared interface" requirement) — each item below fills in a mechanical detail those, the OpenAPI
7	contract, or the prototype extract leave open.
8	
9	## R1 — Where does "this message was already saved" live for FR-008's restart-safety?
10	
11	**Decision**: `ChatRepository` (domain) gains two new members:
12	
13	```dart
14	String? savedEntryIdFor(String chatMessageId);
15	Future<void> recordMessageSaved({required String chatMessageId, required String entryId});
16	```
17	
18	`savedEntryIdFor` is a synchronous read of an in-memory `Map<String, String>` that `ChatRepositoryImpl` loads
19	from a new `ChatLocalCache` key (`chatSavedMessageEntryIds`) inside the exact same `_ensureLocalCacheLoaded()`
20	future every other `ChatRepositoryImpl` method already awaits before returning
21	(`createSession`/`listSessions`/`listMessages` all await it today). `ChatBloc` only ever calls
22	`savedEntryIdFor` from inside `_loadSession`, strictly after `listMessages(sessionId)` has resolved — which
23	means `_ensureLocalCacheLoaded()` has, by construction, already completed, so the read is always safe without
24	needing its own `await`. `recordMessageSaved` upserts the map and persists it via a new
25	`ChatLocalCache.writeSavedMessageEntryIds()`, called once, right after a bookmark's `CreateEntryUseCase` call
26	succeeds.
27	
28	**Rationale**: this is a device-local, per-viewer convenience exactly as spec.md's own Assumptions describe it
29	("a device-local record of which messages this client has already saved; that record is a convenience, not a
30	correctness mechanism") — mirroring the identical shape `ChatLocalCache` already uses for
31	`chatSessionsLocalCache`/`chatMessagesLocalCache`/`chatLastActiveSessionId` (three independent keys, one
32	lazy-loaded future, each read only after that future is known to have resolved). Keeping it behind
33	`ChatRepository` (never exposed as a raw `ChatLocalCache` read to `ChatBloc`) preserves the same
34	presentation-depends-on-repository-only layering every other bloc in this codebase already observes.
35	
36	**Alternatives considered**: deriving "already saved" by scanning `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` for a

42	rejected: `ChatLocalCache` already exists, already mirrors `EntriesLocalCache`'s exact per-feature-cache
43	rationale, and a 4th independent key costs nothing a new class would also need (same constructor, same
44	`FlutterSecureStorage` instance, same JSON-encode-on-write pattern).

46	## R2 — Extending `CreateEntryUseCase`/`EntriesRepository.create` without touching existing callers
47	
48	**Decision**: add two optional, named parameters — `chatMessageId` and `occurredAt`, both defaulting to
49	`null` — through all four layers already in the create path: `CreateEntryUseCase.call`,
50	`EntriesRepository.create`, `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create`, `EntriesRemoteDataSource.create`.
51	`EntriesRemoteDataSource.create`'s request body includes `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt` only when each is
52	non-null (the same optional-field-omission style `list`/`search` already use for their own optional query
53	parameters), exactly matching the OpenAPI schema (`entries-create`'s request body: `chatMessageId` —
54	`format: uuid`, optional; `occurredAt` — `format: date-time`, optional).
55	
56	**Rationale**: `create_entry_usecase.dart`'s own doc comment has named this extension point since RF01 shipped
57	("RF10 will extend this signature, never bypass it"). Positional-with-named-optional-additions is the only
58	shape that leaves every existing call site (`SaveTextEntryUseCase`'s and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`'s three
59	manual/audio/photo sites) byte-for-byte untouched — they already call `_createEntryUseCase(content, source)`
60	positionally, which remains valid with the new named parameters simply omitted.
61	
62	**Alternatives considered**: a parallel `CreateChatEntryUseCase` class — rejected, FR-009 explicitly wants
63	*one* shared interface every feature creating an entry depends on, not a second, chat-specific one that would
64	duplicate `CreateEntryUseCase`'s single orchestration line for no behavioral difference; making the two new
65	fields positional — rejected, would force every existing call site to be edited for no reason.
66	
67	## R3 — `occurredAt`'s value
68	
69	**Decision**: the bookmark flow always passes the originating `ChatMessage.createdAt` (the message's own send
70	time) as `occurredAt`, exactly as spec.md's Assumptions state ("the chat message's own `createdAt` timestamp...
71	not the moment the user taps the bookmark"). Every other existing caller continues to omit `occurredAt`
72	entirely, leaving the backend's own default (creation time = now) exactly as it behaves today for manual/
73	audio/photo entries — confirmed no regression, since the parameter is optional and no current caller passes
74	it.
75	
76	**Rationale**: a bookmark can be tapped well after the message was sent (the user keeps chatting, then later
77	taps an earlier message's bookmark) — using "now" instead of the message's own `createdAt` would place the
78	resulting entry at the wrong point in the user's timeline, the exact failure mode the Assumption calls out.
79	
80	## R4 — Where the bookmark's orchestration logic lives
81	
82	**Decision**: `ChatBloc` gains exactly one new constructor dependency, `CreateEntryUseCase` — the sanctioned
83	shared seam FR-009 names directly, never `EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource` — and handles the whole
84	bookmark flow inline via one new event (`BookmarkTapped(messageId)`) and one new private handler
85	(`_onBookmarkTapped`). No dedicated `SaveChatMessageUseCase`/`BookmarkRepository` class is introduced.
86	
87	**Rationale**: this is the identical judgment RF04's own research.md R13 already made for every other
88	`ChatBloc` handler ("no extra use-case layer... every event it handles belongs to the one conversation
89	screen's one flow"). The bookmark handler needs exactly two calls — `CreateEntryUseCase(...)` and, on success,
90	`ChatRepository.recordMessageSaved(...)` — neither of which has any behavior of its own beyond what the
91	handler already needs inline (resolve the message by id, guard its current status, emit `saving`, await the
92	result, emit `saved`/`error`). A separate `BookmarkBloc` was also considered and rejected: it would either need
93	to duplicate `ChatBloc`'s own `messages` list (to resolve a `messageId` to its `content`/`createdAt`) or import
94	`ChatBloc` directly, which this codebase's established "no BLoC imports another BLoC directly" convention
95	(RF07's own acceptance criterion, reinforced by RF04's research.md R7) forbids.
96	
97	**Alternatives considered**: a `SaveChatMessageUseCase` wrapping both calls for symmetry with `capture/`'s
98	use-case classes — rejected, `capture/`'s use cases exist because `InsertionModalBloc` fans out across several
99	structurally different tabs each needing an independently-testable "what does Save do here" unit; `ChatBloc`'s
100	bookmark flow has no such fan-out, so the wrapper would add a file and a DI registration with zero
101	testability gain over mocking `CreateEntryUseCase`/`ChatRepository` directly, the same level every other
102	`ChatBloc` test already mocks at.
103	
104	## R5 — Per-message bookmark state representation
105	
106	**Decision**: `ChatReady` gains one new field, `Map<String, BookmarkStatus> bookmarks` (default `const {}`,
107	keyed by `ChatMessage.id`; an absent key means `idle`), plus a helper
108	`BookmarkStatus bookmarkStatusFor(String messageId) => bookmarks[messageId] ?? BookmarkStatus.idle`.
109	`BookmarkStatus` is a new, plain 4-value enum (`idle`, `saving`, `saved`, `error`) in
110	`lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_status.dart`, matching prototype-extract.md's own four named
111	sub-states one-to-one — `ChatMessageBubble`/`BookmarkButton` render directly off it with no translation layer.
112	Whenever `_loadSession` (re)loads a conversation's messages — on `ChatStarted` or `ConversationSelected`, both
113	the cache-fallback and the online-success branch — a new private helper, `_seedBookmarks(messages)`, rebuilds
114	the `bookmarks` map from scratch: for every `role == user` message, it calls
115	`_chatRepository.savedEntryIdFor(m.id)`; a non-null result seeds that message's entry as `saved`, otherwise it
116	is left absent (i.e. `idle`). This is the whole mechanism behind FR-008 — no separate "restore bookmarks" step,
117	no polling.
118	
119	**Rationale**: spec.md's own Key Entities section is explicit that "Bookmark" is "per-message, per-viewer UI
120	state... [that] never itself becomes a persisted record" — a plain side-table keyed by message id, parallel to
121	(not merged into) `messages`, matches that description directly. Folding a `bookmarkStatus` field onto
122	`ChatMessage` itself was the other option and was rejected: `ChatMessage` already matches `chat-messages-list`'s
123	response schema field-for-field (data-model.md's own stated precedent from RF04) and the backend schema has no
124	such field; adding one would blur a transport-shaped entity with a client-only UI concern, and would force
125	every one of `ChatBloc`'s existing `_withId`/`_withContent`/`_withStatus` copy-helpers to additionally thread a
126	field they have no reason to touch today.
127	
128	**Alternatives considered**: as above (field on `ChatMessage`) — rejected for the reasons given; computing
129	`bookmarkStatusFor` by scanning `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` every time it's called, instead of seeding a
130	map once at load time — rejected as both slower (an O(n) scan per message per rebuild) and reintroducing the
131	exact cross-feature-cache-timing coupling R1 already rejected.

133	## R6 — Guarding the one race the prototype's own simulation doesn't model: an optimistic message id
134	
135	**Decision**: `_onBookmarkTapped` resolves the target message by id and, before doing anything else, returns
136	(a silent no-op) if that message's `isOptimistic` getter is `true` (the existing `id.startsWith('local-')`

139	same way a tap on an already-`saving` bookmark is (FR-007's own "ignored" language).

160

195	handler") rather than only its visual appearance. `ChatMessageBubble`'s existing `_isUser` branch is extended:

208

210	`GestureDetector` guarded only by a `null` callback — rejected as functionally equivalent but less literal
211	against FR-003's "carries no tap handler," and not meaningfully simpler to write.
212	
213	## R9 — Session-expiry handling during a bookmark save (Edge Cases)
214	
215	**Decision**: `_onBookmarkTapped`'s failure branch checks `if (failure is AuthExpiredFailure)
216	_reauthController.add(null);` before setting the bookmark to `error` — the exact same one-line pattern
217	`_consumeTurn`'s `_applyFailure` branch and `_loadSession`'s failure branch already use for every other
218	`AuthExpiredFailure` this bloc can see. The bookmark itself still ends in `error` (retryable) either way; no
219	silent-refresh-and-retry is added to `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create()` itself.
220	
221	**Rationale**: spec.md's Edge Cases explicitly names this path ("the existing overlay takes over as it already
222	does for the rest of the screen; once re-authenticated, the bookmark reflects the save's actual outcome rather
223	than being stuck mid-attempt"). Firing `reauthRequired` raises the same "Sessão expirada" overlay every other
224	auth-expiry path in this screen already raises; leaving the bookmark in `error` (rather than inventing an
225	auto-retry) satisfies "reflects the save's actual outcome" (a failed attempt did, in fact, fail) while staying
226	tappable once the user re-authenticates and taps again — no new state, no new retry machinery.
227	
228	**Alternatives considered**: adding a silent-refresh-and-retry to `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create()` (mirroring
229	`list()`/`search()`'s own `_retryAfterSilentRefresh`) — rejected as out of this unit's scope: `create()`'s

231	to change it; the overlay-plus-retryable-error path already satisfies the stated Edge Case without touching
232	RF01's existing, shipped behavior.
233	
234	## R10 — No connectivity pre-check gate before a bookmark save
235	
236	**Decision**: unlike `ChatBloc`'s message-send path (which blocks client-side on `ConnectivityChecker.
237	hasConnection()` before even attempting a send, per FR-012 of RF04), the bookmark flow performs **no**
238	pre-check — it always calls `CreateEntryUseCase` and lets a genuine offline condition surface as the ordinary
239	`NetworkOfflineFailure` `Either.Left`, mapped to the same `error` bookmark state as any other failure.
240	
241	**Rationale**: spec.md's own Acceptance Scenario (US3 Scenario 1) describes tapping while offline as
242	transitioning through `saving` and landing on `error` ("the control shows a saving indicator... and, instead
243	of getting stuck, moves to the error state") — not as a blocked, never-attempted tap the way RF04's composer
244	behaves. The Edge Cases section reinforces this by listing "no connection" as just one interchangeable cause
245	among several ("timeout," "PII check fails," "embedding step fails") that all produce the identical `error`
246	outcome, with the explicit note that "the user is not expected to distinguish the underlying cause." Adding a
247	pre-check here would special-case connectivity failures differently from every other failure cause the spec
248	treats uniformly, for no stated benefit.
249	
250	**Alternatives considered**: reusing RF04's pre-check pattern for consistency across the screen — rejected, it
251	would contradict the Acceptance Scenario's own described sequence (`saving` → `error`, not "nothing happens"),
252	and the two flows have a genuinely different failure-isolation requirement to begin with (RF04 must prevent an
253	entire conversation turn from starting; RF10 only ever affects one message's own bookmark, so there is nothing
254	broader to protect by blocking early).

same way a tap on an already-`saving` bookmark is (FR-007's own "ignored" language).

**Rationale**: a user message is appended to `ChatReady.messages` the instant it's typed (RNF01's optimistic
placeholder, RF04's research.md R5), with a client-generated `'local-<timestamp>'` id, before the backend's
`message_created` SSE event assigns the real one. The bookmark control is rendered for every user message
regardless of status (FR-001 has no exception for "message not yet acknowledged by the server"), so a tap
during that narrow window is reachable in principle. Sending a `'local-...'` string as `chatMessageId` would
violate the OpenAPI field's own `format: uuid` constraint and either get rejected outright or (worse) write an
entry with a `chatMessageId` that resolves to nothing once reconciliation happens. Neither `requirements.md`
nor the prototype (whose own simulated bookmark has no server-roundtrip concept at all — every message id is
assigned client-side, synchronously, forever) describes this race, so Principle I's "reasonable technical
decision" applies directly.

**Alternatives considered**: hiding/disabling the bookmark visually while a message is optimistic — rejected,
FR-001 requires the control present on every user message "with no exceptions," and a new, narrower
disabled-look state is unneeded complexity when a silent no-op (identical in spirit to the already-specified
"ignore a tap while `saving`" behavior) is simpler and satisfies both FR-001 and correctness at once; queuing
the tap to fire automatically once the real id arrives — rejected as speculative scope nothing in spec.md asks
for, for a window typically sub-second long in practice.

## R7 — Icon/token mapping (visual fidelity, RNF08)

**Decision**: transcribed directly from the prototype's own inline bookmark markup
(`docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`): a 16 dp icon, bottom-aligned in the same row as the user bubble
(not inside it), with a 6 dp gap between bubble and icon; colors `#6B6255` (`DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary`,
`idle`/`saving`), `#C98A3E` (`DesignTokens.colorAccent`, `saved`), `#B3402A` (`DesignTokens.colorError`,
`error`); a continuous 1 s linear spin only in `saving`. Two new `DesignTokens` constants are added for the two
values with no existing match on the 4 dp spacing/size scale — `sizeBookmarkIcon = 16` and
`spacingBookmarkGap = 6` — following the exact precedent `sizeAudioRecordIcon`/`sizePhotoTileIcon`/
`borderWidthFocused` (RF01–RF03) already set for off-grid, element-specific values read straight off the
prototype rather than rounded to the nearest 4 dp step. Every color is reused verbatim — zero new color
tokens.

Icon glyphs: this codebase has no Phosphor dependency (every prior unit already substitutes a
semantically-equivalent Material glyph — e.g. `capture_status_views.dart` already maps the prototype's
`warning-circle` to `Icons.error_outline`). Mapping used here: `idle` → `Icons.bookmark_border`; `saving` → the
same rotating-arc technique `CaptureLoadingIndicator` already establishes (`RotationTransition` over a
fixed-sweep `CircularProgressIndicator`), reused at the new 16 dp size; `saved` → `Icons.check` (the
prototype's own choice is a plain checkmark, `ph-check`, not a circled one); `error` → `Icons.error_outline`
(the exact glyph/color pairing `RecognitionErrorView` already uses for the same "red warning" semantic).

**Rationale**: Principle IV requires every visual value to trace to the prototype through `design_tokens.dart`
with zero hardcoding elsewhere; reading the actual rendered pixel values out of the prototype's own source
(rather than approximating with the nearest existing 4 dp token) is the only way to satisfy RNF08's "spacing
matches the prototype" for a value that genuinely isn't a multiple of 4.

**Alternatives considered**: rounding 6 dp up to the existing `spacingSm` (8 dp) to avoid adding a token —
rejected, a visible, measurable deviation from the prototype for no reason stronger than "avoid one constant";
adding the `phosphor_flutter` package to render the prototype's exact glyphs — rejected, new dependency for
icons every prior unit already substitutes with Material equivalents without it.

## R8 — Widget composition and placement

**Decision**: a new, small `BookmarkButton` widget (`lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/bookmark_button.dart`),
taking `(BookmarkStatus status, VoidCallback? onTap)`. Its own `GestureDetector` is **omitted entirely** (not
merely disabled) whenever `status` is `saving` or `saved` — matching FR-003's literal wording ("carries no tap
handler") rather than only its visual appearance. `ChatMessageBubble`'s existing `_isUser` branch is extended:
the bubble `Container` and a `BookmarkButton` are wrapped in a `Row` (`crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end`,
a `spacingBookmarkGap`-wide gap between them), replacing the bare bubble, matching the prototype's own
row-wrapped markup (bubble + bookmark bottom-aligned, gap 6 dp, timestamp below the whole row — unchanged).
The assistant branch is untouched; `BookmarkButton` is never instantiated there, so FR-001's "no exceptions" —
including insight cards and streaming/failed assistant bubbles, none of which are rendered by the `_isUser`
branch at all — holds by construction, not by an extra conditional.

**Rationale**: matches the prototype's own markup structure exactly (a `flex` row containing the bubble and
the bookmark icon, bottom-aligned, the timestamp below) rather than approximating a different layout.
Omitting the `GestureDetector`/tap region entirely for `saving`/`saved` (rather than wrapping it and setting
`onTap: null`, which Flutter's own `GestureDetector` already treats as inert, but would still carry a widget
whose *name* suggests interactivity) keeps the implementation legible against FR-003's specific wording.

**Alternatives considered**: a single `AnimatedSwitcher`-driven icon swap with an always-present
`GestureDetector` guarded only by a `null` callback — rejected as functionally equivalent but less literal
against FR-003's "carries no tap handler," and not meaningfully simpler to write.

## R9 — Session-expiry handling during a bookmark save (Edge Cases)

**Decision**: `_onBookmarkTapped`'s failure branch checks `if (failure is AuthExpiredFailure)
_reauthController.add(null);` before setting the bookmark to `error` — the exact same one-line pattern
`_consumeTurn`'s `_applyFailure` branch and `_loadSession`'s failure branch already use for every other
`AuthExpiredFailure` this bloc can see. The bookmark itself still ends in `error` (retryable) either way; no
silent-refresh-and-retry is added to `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create()` itself.

**Rationale**: spec.md's Edge Cases explicitly names this path ("the existing overlay takes over as it already
does for the rest of the screen; once re-authenticated, the bookmark reflects the save's actual outcome rather
than being stuck mid-attempt"). Firing `reauthRequired` raises the same "Sessão expirada" overlay every other
auth-expiry path in this screen already raises; leaving the bookmark in `error` (rather than inventing an
auto-retry) satisfies "reflects the save's actual outcome" (a failed attempt did, in fact, fail) while staying
tappable once the user re-authenticates and taps again — no new state, no new retry machinery.

**Alternatives considered**: adding a silent-refresh-and-retry to `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create()` (mirroring
`list()`/`search()`'s own `_retryAfterSilentRefresh`) — rejected as out of this unit's scope: `create()`'s
retry behavior is RF01-owned, shared by every other caller (manual/audio/photo), and spec.md never asks RF10
to change it; the overlay-plus-retryable-error path already satisfies the stated Edge Case without touching
RF01's existing, shipped behavior.

## R10 — No connectivity pre-check gate before a bookmark save

**Decision**: unlike `ChatBloc`'s message-send path (which blocks client-side on `ConnectivityChecker.
hasConnection()` before even attempting a send, per FR-012 of RF04), the bookmark flow performs **no**
pre-check — it always calls `CreateEntryUseCase` and lets a genuine offline condition surface as the ordinary
`NetworkOfflineFailure` `Either.Left`, mapped to the same `error` bookmark state as any other failure.

**Rationale**: spec.md's own Acceptance Scenario (US3 Scenario 1) describes tapping while offline as
transitioning through `saving` and landing on `error` ("the control shows a saving indicator... and, instead
of getting stuck, moves to the error state") — not as a blocked, never-attempted tap the way RF04's composer
behaves. The Edge Cases section reinforces this by listing "no connection" as just one interchangeable cause
among several ("timeout," "PII check fails," "embedding step fails") that all produce the identical `error`
outcome, with the explicit note that "the user is not expected to distinguish the underlying cause." Adding a
pre-check here would special-case connectivity failures differently from every other failure cause the spec
treats uniformly, for no stated benefit.

**Alternatives considered**: reusing RF04's pre-check pattern for consistency across the screen — rejected, it
would contradict the Acceptance Scenario's own described sequence (`saving` → `error`, not "nothing happens"),
and the two flows have a genuinely different failure-isolation requirement to begin with (RF04 must prevent an
entire conversation turn from starting; RF10 only ever affects one message's own bookmark, so there is nothing
broader to protect by blocking early).
